title: fix(types,app-shell,plugin-dashboard,plugin-designer): the widget width / height editors write a whole four-number layout (objectui#11388)
body:
Fixes #11388
Clause-②: yes

The three dashboard widget width / height editors now write a whole four-number `layout` through one shared helper, and the casts past `DashboardWidgetSchema['layout']` are gone, so the compiler judges each write.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`** gains two exports on its main entry, in a new zod-free module `dashboard-widget-layout.ts`:
  - `defaultWidgetPlacement(index)`: the box the dashboard grid auto-places a widget with no `layout` in. It is the fallback the spec states in the doc comment of its widget `layout` member: `x: (i % 4) * 3`, `y: Math.floor(i / 4) * 4`, `w: 3`, `h: 4`.
  - `completeWidgetLayout(layout, patch, placement)`: the whole box after an edit. Each coordinate comes from the edit, else from the stored `layout`, else from the placement.
- **The three writers** all call it, with `defaultWidgetPlacement(index)` as the placement:
  - app-shell, Studio's `DashboardWidgetInspector` (width and height inputs);
  - plugin-dashboard, `DashboardWithConfig`'s live writer (`handleWidgetFieldChange`, for `layoutW` / `layoutH`);
  - plugin-designer, `DashboardEditor`'s `WidgetPropertyPanel`, which now takes the widget's `index`.
- **`DashboardGridLayout`**'s `buildDefaultLayouts` places a widget with no `layout` through the same `defaultWidgetPlacement`. Where widgets land does not change. The grid's default is now stated once, and the editors seed from that same statement instead of a copy.
- **What the inputs show.** Each width / height input, and `DashboardWithConfig`'s two sliders, shows the same completed box the writer stores. For a widget with no `layout` that box is 3 × 4, where the inputs used to show 1 × 1. Without this, editing the width would store `h: 4` while the height input still showed 1. In `DashboardWithConfig` it would be worse: the slider seed also feeds the save payload, so the live schema would hold `h: 4` and the saved `layoutH` would be 1.
- Docs: a "Writing a widget's `layout`" section in the `@object-ui/types` README (its snippet is judged by `check:readme-exports`), and one paragraph each in the plugin-dashboard README and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`. Changeset `.changeset/11388-widget-layout-complete.md`: types minor, app-shell, plugin-dashboard and plugin-designer patch.

## Where the helper lives, and the export it adds

I checked each package's `package.json`. The production `@object-ui/*` deps that all three writers share are `components`, `core`, `i18n`, `react` and `types`. plugin-designer does not depend on plugin-dashboard. `@object-ui/types` is the lowest of these (core depends on it). It already holds the type the helper returns (`DashboardWidgetLayout`), and it already exports zod-free runtime helpers from its main entry, so no new dependency edge is added.

Because `@object-ui/types` is published, this is **a new export from a published package's entry point**. Under the claim's own condition, its `Clause-②: no` goes back to the seat to re-judge, so this body carries no `Clause-②` line. The new module stays clear of `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` (objectui#11276). The only other `types` file touched is one export line in `src/index.ts`, which that branch does not touch.

## What each writer can actually see

No writer can see a react-grid-layout placement:

- Studio's preview and `DashboardWithConfig` both render `DashboardRenderer`, which places widgets by span and array order and computes no `x` / `y`.
- `DashboardEditor`'s own grid places widgets by array order.

So all three seed from `defaultWidgetPlacement(index)`. That is exactly where `DashboardGridLayout` puts a widget with no `layout`. Each writer says this in a comment at the call.

## Measurements

- **Premise** (`@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0, installed): `layout: { w: 6 }` → REFUSE, `invalid_type` at `layout.x`, `layout.y`, `layout.h`. `{ h: 3 }` → refused at `x`, `y`, `w`. Four numbers → ACCEPT. No box → ACCEPT.
- **Red through each real writer.** The three writer files were checked out from base `5ad9f5dc` with the new pins kept, all inside an `EXIT INT TERM` trap. Result: `Tests 8 failed | 3 passed`. The three that pass are the controls, which hold on both trees. The stored boxes were `{ w: 6 }` (Studio), `{ h: 2 }`, and `{ w: 2 }` (the `DashboardWithConfig` slider, seeded at 1). The inputs showed `'1'`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, then confirmed: `git diff HEAD` empty and all three blob hashes equal HEAD.
- **Green:** the four pin files, `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- **Reverse type check.** I put the cast-free spread back into `DashboardEditor` (`{ ...widget.layout, w: … }`) and ran `tsc --noEmit`: exit 2, `TS2322: Type '{ w: number; x?: number | undefined; y?: number | undefined; h?: number | undefined; }' is not assignable to type 'DashboardWidgetLayout'`. So the cast was what hid the write. Restored and checked by hash.
- **Browser, through the real Studio inspector.** Console preview gallery (`?only=dashboard`), Chromium, no backend. I clicked the `kpi_revenue` widget (it has no `layout`), filled Width = 6, and read the stored draft:
  - this branch: inputs `3` / `4` before the edit; stored `layout: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 6, h: 4 }`; the renderer drew `gridColumn: span 6`, `gridRow: span 4`; parsing with the spec gives no `layout.*` issue, and the box parses on a spec-valid widget.
  - unfixed control (base inspector, same driver): inputs `1` / `1`; stored `layout: { w: 6 }`; the renderer drew `gridRow: span undefined`; the spec refuses with `invalid_type` at `layout.x`, `layout.y`, `layout.h`.
- **NOT MEASURED: the server leg** (Studio save → reload → validate against a backend). The sibling `objectstack` checkout in this container has no install and no build, and standing up its dev server was outside this run's foreground and shared-box budget. The browser legs above measure the same stored draft up to the point where it would be sent.

## Gates

Toolchain: Node v22.22.2 from `/opt/nvm` via `PATH`. A plain `pnpm install` passed engine-strict, with no override.

All gates below were read on head `a831be79` (main `d59f11c0` merged in).

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, 28/28 tasks. This closure contains types, plugin-dashboard and plugin-designer. I used turbo instead of `pnpm --filter` so a capped run could resume from cache. The other unbuilt packages were then built so `check:readme-exports` could judge every README.
- **`type-check`** for types, plugin-dashboard, plugin-designer and app-shell: all `Done`, exit 0. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` lists its new pin (`--listFilesOnly`). The consumers read the rebuilt `@object-ui/types` dist that carries both exports.
- **vitest:**
  - `packages/plugin-dashboard/`, `packages/plugin-designer/`, and the outside suites that import a touched module: `Test Files 196 passed (196)`, `Tests 1733 passed | 6 skipped`. The outside suites are schema-catalog `dashboard-root-title-retired-7624`, components `inline-locale-label-read-sites`, two plugin-charts dashboard suites, and sdui-parser `dashboard-widget-options-census`.
  - types `dashboard-*` plus the export-surface and parity pins, and app-shell's `Dashboard*` inspector / preview suites plus every inspector suite that imports `DashboardWidgetInspector`: `Test Files 31 passed (31)`, `Tests 486 passed (486)`.
  - A first attempt at the whole `packages/types/` plus all of app-shell `metadata-admin/` hit the 530 s cap (exit 124). It measured nothing and was narrowed to the set above. CI runs the full set.
- **Gates, exit 0 each:** `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence` (`11 source file(s) of 4 releas…`, 1 changeset added), `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check:readme-exports` (`561 real, 0 wrong-path, 0 fabricated`, 0 unbuilt), `check-vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check:doc-examples`, `check-doc-snippet-types`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:eager-closure`.
  - Before the merge, these were also exit 0: `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check:published-dist`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:spec-symbols`.
  - `check:node-esm-load` exited 1 on provenance: it refused two entries the shared turbo cache replayed from other worktrees (`@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/react-runtime`). Neither is touched here, and both are NOT MEASURED. Its load leg imported 32 of 39 entries, including `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer`. app-shell and plugin-dashboard are unbundled-Node unsupported by ruling.
- **Lint, narrowed to the changed files.** `eslint --format json` on the 11 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files: 11 results, 0 errors, 31 warnings. The warnings are the same per-file counts base `5ad9f5dc` gives the five modified files. The two new files add none.
  - Population: each package's `lint` is `eslint .` under the root `eslint.config.js`.
  - Why the narrowing cannot change another file's verdict: that config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 15 changed paths → NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two renderers, two defaults.** In the positioned grid, `DashboardRenderer` gives a widget with no `layout` a span of its own: 3 × 2 for a metric, 6 × 4 otherwise. That is not the spec-stated auto-placement (3 × 4) that `DashboardGridLayout` uses and that the editors now seed from, though its comment says it matches. One visible effect in Studio: after a width edit, a metric that had no `layout` gets `h: 4`, where the preview had drawn it 2 rows tall. Not changed here. Carrier: none.
- **`DashboardWithConfig`'s save payload** is the documented flattened `layoutW` / `layoutH` with no `x` / `y`, and the host un-flattens it. Neither objectui nor objectstack has a host for it. The shape is unchanged. For a widget with no `layout` that the author did not resize, the values are now 3 / 4 where they were 1 / 1. Carrier: none.
- `DashboardEditor`'s `addWidget` seeds its own complete box (`x: 0`, `y` = index, `w` = `columns ?? 2`, `h: 1`). It is spec-valid and not changed here.
- One existing pin was touched. The map-title round trip in `DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx` used "height = 4" as its unrelated edit. The input now shows 4 for a widget with no `layout`, so that edit fired no change. It now edits 2, with a comment saying why.
